description: Minimum palindrome partition with eertree series-link DP and deterministic partition reconstruction.

source.title: Palindromic Tree — Minimum Palindromic Partition
source.algorithm_attribution: Eertree suffix links are grouped by diff; series links aggregate prefix-DP candidates across each arithmetic progression of palindromic suffix lengths.
source.implementation_status: Clean-room bounded algorithm ports; no article code, prose, examples, or test data copied.

output.partition_order: Left-to-right lengths; among optimal partitions of each prefix, choose the smallest preceding prefix index, which prefers the longest final palindrome. Reconstruct repeatedly from the full prefix toward zero.
output.success_result: 8 times the number of output words

algorithm_contract.dp: dp[i] is the minimum number of palindromic pieces covering the first i symbols.
algorithm_contract.series_recurrence: For each palindromic suffix series representative v at prefix i, seed its aggregate with dp[i-len[slink[v]]-diff[v]], combine with the cached aggregate of fail[v] when diff[v]==diff[fail[v]], and minimize dp[i] with aggregate+1.
algorithm_contract.tie_rule: For equal minimum piece counts at a prefix, choose the smaller predecessor prefix index.
algorithm_contract.empty_text: The empty text has zero pieces and serializes as [0].

workspace.meaning: Fixed four-symbol eertree transitions, suffix/series-link state, prefix DP, predecessors, and staged output words.
